metadata.description: Benchmark-data snapshot for Robot SF covering 14 planner arms, 48 social-navigation scenarios, and 30 seeds with independently pinned authored horizons (400/500/600/650/700), dt=0.1 and differential-drive kinematics (20,160 expected episode identities). The archive preserves raw episode and component-metric evidence with exact source provenance: source commit 66f402ba176b13e45210d0da0b2cf20fcdc0cc02, mainline base 1261295887901e566a93da87a4559ea1040808a7, release tag paper-matrix-v2-h600-s30-2026-10-66f402ba176b13e45210d0da0b2cf20fcdc0cc02, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23150471, and version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23150472. The Social Navigation Quality Index (SNQI) is advisory only because calibration failed; this release makes no SNQI ranking claim.
metadata.title: Robot SF 14-planner S30 authored-budget benchmark dataset
